final: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(source_stats.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(source_stats.project_count) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(source_stats.project_count - cross_source.avg_project_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats CROSS JOIN cross_source WHERE source_stats.project_count > cross_source.avg_project_count
